asking.venue: AbeBooks, seller Haymes Bookdealers, Kingscliff NSW
asking.note: Page opened. Only listing for this title on AbeBooks that day. Hardcover, first edition, signed, 'a fine copy in a fine dustjacket housed in the original black cloth slip case; 4to; 528 pages; edition limited to 2000 numbered and signed copies'. Same edition as the Gowans copy. Dealer asking price, not a price paid, and for a Fine copy. AUD at 1 USD = 1.4308 AUD (open.er-api.com, 30 Sep 2026), about A$414 excluding shipping; researcher's A$434 used an assumed 1.50 rate and is corrected here. Seller is Australian so the USD figure is AbeBooks conversion of an AUD price.

lots.guide_summary: One asking price only (A$414, Fine copy, dealer). No sold or unsold results found. Rate 1 USD = 1.4308 AUD.
lots.working: No SOLD evidence, so keep and flip maximums are both 0. Asking price is a retail ceiling, not a value; an auction copy would normally sell well under a Fine dealer copy.
lots.confidence_reason: Identification certain (limitation page and signatures read in photos) but the only price is a single dealer asking price.
lots.key_photo_findings: Photo 2 shows the limitation page 'This is copy 1420 / 2000' with two ink signatures (first reads as Fahy, second consistent with Simpson). Green pictorial dust jacket looks clean and glossy. Black cloth slipcase shows mild shelf rubbing at edges only. Book block, spine ends, page edges, hinges and plates not shown. Catalogue misspells the author as Fahey.
lots.condition: Jacket and slipcase look very good in photos; interior not shown.
lots.question_for_gowans: Please confirm the interior is clean (no foxing, water damage or loose pages), the spine and corners of the book itself are sound, and the jacket has no tears under the slipcase.
lots.dropped_entries: None dropped. The AbeBooks entry was reopened and matches (price, seller, edition); only the AUD figure was corrected from A$434 to A$414 using a live rate.

lots.key_photo_findings: Enlarged base crop: incised script 'John Campbell / Tasmania' with '3.L.O' above, on a green-glazed base inside an unglazed foot ring. Squat bulbous body, flared neck, two twisted rope-style loop handles, streaky green and turquoise drip glaze, dark olive interior. No chips or cracks visible on rim or handles at this resolution. Foot ring is unglazed with a few small pale glaze-skip patches, normal for the ware but should be checked for flakes.
lots.condition: Appears good with no visible damage; minor glaze skips at foot ring; small photos (800 px) so fine hairlines cannot be ruled out.
lots.question_for_gowans: Please confirm there are no chips, hairlines or restorations to the rim, handles (especially handle joins) or foot ring.
lots.dropped_entries: None dropped; the researcher supplied no entries. All entries here were found by me by parsing the Invaluable John Campbell artist page. Excluded from that page as a different John Campbell or not pottery: Lawsons 2024 watercolour, Adam's 2017 oil, New Orleans 2015 oil.
